study.question: After the locally supported target-match partition, is within-event action/recency association useful beyond group-specific action and age marginals, and does any utility depend on alignment to the target? Only the current proposal phase is authorized; host training and validation follow submission.
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation from source inspection: each incumbent group retains mean(E_category+E_brand+E_action+E_age). Exchanging two action IDs between events of the SAME group leaves every incumbent feature identical for every parameter setting if category/brand, ages and group membership stay fixed. The action/age contingency can change. Diagnostics from g1-r0005-match_groups show 118.115 visible events and 107.867 neither-match events on the first 512 impressions, so within-group collisions are feasible, not demonstrated predictive failures. Hypothesis: preserving action-by-coarse-age counts recovers useful joint information at low cost. This is unverified predictive utility, not an observed temporal causal effect. Review of trajectories: static .605004 < pooled .610226 < DIN .613362; behavior/field splits did not improve DIN. Joint_count .617127 and independent_count .617123 were almost tied, while rate .614756 was weaker: global category/brand co-occurrence was NOT established as useful. Count-only .613095 and activity-only .605374 showed learned values matter; removing target relevance with content_activity .610574 was adverse. Mean_match .616519 and content_match .616497 lost to .617127. Match pools .618800 beat same-allocation rank .616923 and occupied_global .617442. These are single-seed controlled directions, not repeated support; no failed execution appears in supplied trajectories, and scientific underperformance is not an execution failure. The current question changes the interaction fields and conditions on relevance; it does not generalize the earlier category/brand joint-count null into a positive claim.

nearest_work.difference: DIN discusses pooled-interest bottlenecks and target-conditioned weighted sums, including intensity lost through normalization. Inherit shared embeddings and MLP lineage from a local field-adapted reference. Proposed addition is fixed action/age contingency counts conditional on hard target-match groups, with exact raw marginal-preserving independence replacements; no learned attention, DIN reproduction or priority claim.

Author README confirms history has category, brand and behavior but no item. Use only supplied category/brand/action/age, never invent item IDs or auxiliary supervision. Full publisher paper was unavailable, so no verified detailed architectural comparison to DMR is asserted.

Inherit all learned true-match means and four count statistics. Add 64 fixed count coordinates (4 relevance groups x 4 actions x 4 fixed age bins), preserving association that additive group means erase. Contrast exact versus factorized counts and true-match versus same-cardinality rank assignment for ONLY the added tables. This is a local mechanism difference, not verified global novelty.

inherited_components: Same field embeddings, category/brand sharing, action and 33-bin recency embeddings, four true-match uniform learned means, N/C/B/J log counts and [128,64] MLP lineage
Ancestor dormant 4226-parameter attention scorer retained and never executed in every new variant
Default host Adam/BCE, lr .001, three epochs, full frozen exposure coverage, seed 42; no custom optimizer, auxiliary labels or loss
Existing input age for learned recency embeddings stays unchanged; only the new count table bins seconds at fixed 3600, 86400 and 604800 boundaries
study.proposed_difference: Append a flattened 4x4x4 table to the unchanged parent representation. Coarse age bins are [0,3600), [3600,86400), [86400,604800), [604800,infinity) seconds, chosen prospectively without validation fitting. Count each valid event once in a group/action/age cell. Observed J versus independence A outer T / max(group size,1) preserves both RAW groupwise margins and total; log1p(cell)/log(129) is applied to either. An orthogonal grouping switch routes the added table by semantic equality or valid-position prefix partitions preserving exact per-example semantic group sizes. True-match learned pools and N/C/B/J stay fixed in all four cells. Same class and allocation order, 8192 additional first-layer weights, no new embeddings. Both tables are computed in every variant. Numeric-only standalone modules with no I/O. Authorized-source searches for interaction pooling cooccurrence and factorization returned no additional primary papers; nearest-work coverage is incomplete and novelty remains unverified.
predictions: Primary association prediction: AUC(paired_match) > AUC(factorized_match). Logloss must be reported even if it disagrees. A gap >=0.0003 is a follow-up trigger, not a significance threshold.
Conditional-relevance prediction: [AUC(paired_match)-AUC(factorized_match)] - [AUC(paired_rank)-AUC(factorized_rank)] > 0. Otherwise restrict any claim to general action/age association.

Raw joint and factorized action/time margins and group totals agree to floating tolerance; empty histories yield zero tables, singleton groups have zero raw association difference, masked values never contribute. Diagnostics are exploratory first-512 host measurements, not population evidence.

Synthetic information collision to verify locally without Torch: two neither-match events with actions pv,buy at ages 60,172800 versus buy,pv at those same ages have identical incumbent field marginals and counts; observed tables differ, factorized tables agree. This proves representational distinction, not label predictiveness.

Predeclared reporting: full-validation AUC/Logloss, parameters, wall/train seconds, peak GPU memory, throughput and p50/p95 latency, plus existing history/hour/action-presence/frequency slices with counts. Primary slices are history_gt64 (3026583 samples,151372 positives) and category_match_present (2516922,129821 positives); other host slices are exploratory. Do not add outcome-selected bins or claim independent-impression significance.

Expected matched-pass end-to-end cost stays below 900 s per cell versus incumbent 560.53 s, but only host measurements can support efficiency. Report any overrun and any quality/cost tradeoff; no equal-compute frontier claim without equal-compute measurement.
falsifiers: Observed match table fails to beat its factorized counterpart, especially after reserved paired seeds: no supported within-event binding gain in this implementation. If independent also beats the parent, finer marginals remain a competing supported explanation.
Association benefits equally or more in rank-assigned groups: relevance-specific binding hypothesis is unsupported even if the package improves AUC.

Near-zero joint-versus-factorized difference or unsupported action/time bins on diagnostics means the implementation provides little usable association contrast; do not infer mechanism failure from an unidentifiable contrast.
Any nonfinite logits/diagnostics, masking violation, group coverage or raw-marginal error above 1e-4 invalidates the implementation contrast and requires a charged repair before interpretation.
No variant improves the parent or offers a measured cost benefit: keep incumbent and report this branch as unsuccessful. One run cannot refute event-binding architectures generally.
alternative_explanations: One seed is preliminary; repeated user exposures are not independent; no bootstrap is claimed without host support
Observed integer counts versus fractional expected counts differ in sparsity and log1p feature geometry; equal allocated parameters does not ensure equal effective capacity or measured runtime
Fixed age boundaries may be too coarse or poorly supported; no validation-derived bin selection
Input IDs are frozen buckets, so equality and target grouping inherit hash collision and missing-field limitations
Gains versus parent can come from finer action/time group marginals or extra dense capacity rather than association. Factorized cells preserve raw marginals and allocation to test this.
Recency is observational; action-time dependence may encode user activity or selection within the frozen last-128 history, not a causal change in intent.
85.156% of first-512 histories reach the cap; this suite cannot recover discarded older history or assess changing information budgets.
Static snapshots lack documented as-of dates. Missing values, coarse IDs and temporal shift limit production interpretation.
Earlier global C/B joint-count null and negative field/action splitting are relevant counterevidence, not proof the present action/age conditional contingency will fail.

Rank replacement changes which event marginals reach each added slot and preserves positional structure; it is a deterministic replacement, not a randomized causal control. Existing g1-r0005-rank_groups changed learned pools and is historical context, not this factorial cell.

contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: If association helps both alignments similarly, claim only general action/age binding utility. A null or adverse interaction does not refute all semantic grouping.
